raw.query: WITH valid_sources AS (SELECT source_path FROM provenance.collector_bench_run WHERE is_valid = true AND source_path IN ('/home/gio/tese/collector_artifacts/phaseE_physical_anchor/anchor_dense_sdpa_2400.json','/home/gio/tese/collector_artifacts/phaseE_physical_anchor/vllm_eager_dense.json')), composed AS (SELECT image_px, n_images, aic_pred_ms AS composed_ms FROM provenance.collector_encoder_fn WHERE source_path = '/home/gio/tese/collector_artifacts/phaseE_physical_anchor/anchor_dense_sdpa_2400.json' AND source_path IN (SELECT source_path FROM valid_sources) AND engine = 'sdpa' AND is_valid = true AND aic_pred_ms IS NOT NULL), vllm AS (SELECT image_px, n_images, mean_ms AS vllm_ms FROM provenance.collector_encoder_fn WHERE source_path = '/home/gio/tese/collector_artifacts/phaseE_physical_anchor/vllm_eager_dense.json' AND source_path IN (SELECT source_path FROM valid_sources) AND engine = 'vllm' AND is_valid = true), errors AS (SELECT image_px, n_images, composed_ms, vllm_ms, abs(vllm_ms-composed_ms)/composed_ms*100.0 AS pct_of_composed, abs(vllm_ms-composed_ms)/vllm_ms*100.0 AS pct_of_vllm FROM composed JOIN vllm USING (image_px,n_images)) SELECT count(*) AS comparable_points, (SELECT count(*) FROM composed) AS composed_points, (SELECT count(*) FROM vllm) AS vllm_points, max(pct_of_composed) AS max_pct_of_composed, max(pct_of_vllm) AS max_pct_of_vllm, (array_agg(n_images ORDER BY pct_of_composed DESC))[1] AS worst_n, (array_agg(composed_ms ORDER BY pct_of_composed DESC))[1] AS worst_composed_ms, (array_agg(vllm_ms ORDER BY pct_of_composed DESC))[1] AS worst_vllm_ms, count(*) FILTER (WHERE pct_of_composed > 12.8) AS points_over_12_8 FROM errors;
